onboarding.desc1: Learn new words in a fun and effective way. Improve your language skills quickly with a personalized learning experience.
onboarding.desc2: Easily track words you know and don't know. Create custom word lists and organize your learning process.
onboarding.desc3: Monitor your learning journey with detailed statistics and visualizations. See how close you are to your goals and stay motivated.

onboarding1.description: Make learning fun with flashcards, matching games, word guessing games, and quizzes!

onboarding2.description: Add unknown words to your list, review them anytime, and easily track your progress! Learning is in your control.

onboarding3.description: Feed your fish with the points you earn, take care of it every day and increase your learning motivation!
